areas.name: Port O'Connor
areas.description: A quiet fishing town on the Texas coast between Matagorda Bay and Espiritu Santo Bay, with the jetties, Matagorda Island and miles of shallow flats close by.

bays.name: Matagorda Bay
bays.description: Big open bay with reefs, shell and deep shorelines.

bays.name: Espiritu Santo Bay
bays.description: Grass flats and back lakes known for sight-casting redfish.

bays.name: San Antonio Bay
bays.description: Shell reefs and marsh drains to the south.

bays.name: Jetties and Gulf
bays.description: The Matagorda ship channel jetties and nearshore Gulf.

listings.address: 110 East Monroe Ave., Port O'Connor, TX 77982
listings.summary: Beach house across the street from Kingfisher Beach with three porches, an outdoor kitchen and bar, and room for 14.
listings.description: Drink your coffee on one of three porches and watch the sun come up over the beach, which is right across the street. Kids have a playscape and basketball court, Boggy Nature Park is about a ten minute walk, and the covered patio has a bar, seating, a TV and an outdoor kitchen for cooking the day's catch. We work with local guides for fishing trips and boat rides to a private beach you can only reach by water, so you can add those to your stay.
listings.title: POC Premier Lodge
highlights: Across the street from Kingfisher Beach
Outdoor kitchen and covered bar with TV
Three porches with sunrise and bay views
Playscape and basketball court for kids
Guided fishing and boat trips can be added
house_rules: Primary guest must be 25 or older (photo ID required)
No smoking, vaping or drugs anywhere on the property
Up to 2 pets, 150 lbs max each (refundable pet deposit)
Trash goes in the big cans downstairs; pickup is Tuesday
Lost keys carry a replacement fee
Extra cleaning after a party is charged
listings.cancellation_policy: Full refund if you cancel within 36 hours of booking and check-in is at least 30 days away. 50% refund if you cancel at least 20 days before check-in. No refund within 20 days of check-in. If weather, an evacuation or damage makes the house unusable, we cancel and refund you.

amenities: All fishing gear, supplied by your guide
All the ice, with an ice chest on board
Your fish cleaned and bagged at the end of the trip
listings.summary: Five hours on the bay for redfish, speckled trout, black drum and flounder. Great for first-timers and kids.
listings.description: Light-tackle inshore trip on a 24 ft bay boat with GPS, live well and trolling motor. Your guide picks the bay, reef or shoreline that is fishing best that day. Rods, tackle and ice are included. Bring your own food and drinks (no glass).
listings.title: Inshore Bay Fishing
what_to_bring: Any food and drinks you like. Adult beverages are fine, but no glass bottles please
A small over-the-shoulder carry-on is OK. Please don't bring your own ice chest: large chests aren't allowed on the boat

amenities: All fishing gear, supplied by your guide
All the ice, with an ice chest on board
Your fish cleaned and bagged at the end of the trip
listings.summary: Sight-cast to redfish on the grass flats and back lakes of Espiritu Santo Bay.
listings.description: Run to the flats, step off the boat and wade for tailing redfish and trout with artificial lures. Best for anglers who want the hunt.
listings.title: Wade Fishing the Flats
what_to_bring: Any food and drinks you like. Adult beverages are fine, but no glass bottles please
A small over-the-shoulder carry-on is OK. Please don't bring your own ice chest: large chests aren't allowed on the boat
Wading boots or old sneakers that stay on in the mud

amenities: All fishing gear, supplied by your guide

listings.summary: Fish the Matagorda ship channel jetties and drift the passes for bull reds and black drum.
listings.description: Structure fishing on the jetties with bait or lures, then drifting the channel when the tide is moving.
listings.title: Jetty and Drift Fishing
what_to_bring: Any food and drinks you like. Adult beverages are fine, but no glass bottles please
A small over-the-shoulder carry-on is OK. Please don't bring your own ice chest: large chests aren't allowed on the boat

listings.summary: An easy evening on the water to watch the sun go down over Matagorda Bay.
listings.description: Relaxed cruise along the shoreline as the sun sets. Bring drinks and snacks (no glass).
listings.title: Sunset Bay Cruise
what_to_bring: Light jacket for the ride back
Phone or camera for the sunset

listings.summary: Boat ride across the bay to the empty beaches of Matagorda Island for shelling and swimming.
listings.description: Cross the bay to the barrier island beaches only reachable by boat. Shelling, swimming and a picnic, then a ride back.
listings.title: Matagorda Island Beach Day
what_to_bring: Water and snacks for the day (no glass)
Beach chairs or an umbrella if you want them
Bag to carry out your trash (the island has no services)

listings.summary: See the islands, reefs and back lakes around Port O'Connor with a local guide.
listings.description: A guided tour of the islands and back country around Port O'Connor, with stops wherever there is something worth seeing.
listings.title: Island and Bay Tour
what_to_bring: Water and snacks for the day (no glass)
Beach chairs or an umbrella if you want them
Bag to carry out your trash (the island has no services)

listings.summary: Roseate spoonbills, herons and, in winter, whooping cranes on the marshes and islands.
listings.description: A quiet morning on the marshes and rookery islands. Bring binoculars and a camera.
listings.title: Coastal Bird Watching
what_to_bring: Camera with a zoom lens if you have one
